title: crusties
description: a mod about crabs that steal things
body:
welcome to crusties!

have you EVER wanted a pet CRAB in minecraft because of the MOB VOTE rejected it?

well worry NOT! crusties (a mod in work) offers just that!

your new CRAB friend can be in the colors: yellow, blue, red, green and more in the future!

BUT thats not all!

when you hit a target, your crab will STEAL the item its holding for you! great for disarming while combat AND steal from unsuspecting players, how fun! (unless they steal from you).

following features are:

-bean crabs: "little crabs who can steal things from mobs and other players"



these feature are made to add some more life and pets to your world.

the mod is a neoforge mod only.
